assists_per90.definition: Pass events with provider goal_assist flag; no inferred assists.
assists_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

ball_recoveries_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

carries_per90.definition: Provider Carry events. Not every touch or dribble attempt.
carries_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

completed_passes_per90.definition: Pass events with absent pass.outcome (provider success encoding).
completed_passes_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

entries_into_box_per90.definition: Completed open-play pass or carry from outside to inside x>=102, 18<=y<=62.
entries_into_box_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

goals_per90.definition: Shot outcome Goal, periods 1–4; excludes own goals and shootouts.
goals_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

interceptions_per90.definition: Interception events; outcomes retained in canonical events, not assumed successful.
interceptions_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

key_passes_per90.definition: Pass with shot_assist or goal_assist. Includes goal-creating passes.
key_passes_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

non_penalty_goals_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

npxg_per90.definition: Sum of provider xG excluding penalties; null if any applicable shot lacks xG.
npxg_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

pass_completion.definition: 100 * completed passes / attempted passes. Null for zero attempts.

passes_into_final_third_per90.definition: Completed open-play pass starts x<80 and ends x>=80 on provider 120x80 pitch.
passes_into_final_third_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

passes_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

pressures_per90.definition: Provider Pressure events; not successful presses. Null if a whole match has no pressure coverage.
pressures_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

progressive_carries_per90.definition: Carry with same distance-to-goal rule as progressive passes.
progressive_carries_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

progressive_passes_per90.definition: Completed open-play pass: forward and reduces distance to goal centre by >=10m AND >=25%. Coordinates scaled to 105x68m. Restarts excluded.
progressive_passes_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

shots_per90.definition: Shot events in periods 1–4, including penalties.
shots_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

tackles_per90.definition: Duel events with subtype Tackle; attempted, not necessarily won.
tackles_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

turnovers_per90.definition: Dispossessed + Miscontrol events only. Excludes failed passes; not all possession losses.
turnovers_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

xa_per90.definition: Sum of linked assisted shot xG; requires same match/team and valid shot link. Not a pass-based xA model.
xa_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90

xg_per90.definition: Sum of provider statsbomb_xg over shots; null if any shot lacks xG.
xg_per90.denominator: On-pitch minutes including stoppage and extra time / 90
